title: The locker puzzle
body: Queen Ratnamanjuri's will takes 100 people, numbered 1 to 100, to a room with 100 closed lockers. Person 1 opens every locker. Person 2 toggles every 2nd locker, that is, closes it if it is open and opens it if it is closed. Person 3 toggles every 3rd locker (3rd, 6th, 9th, and so on), Person 4 toggles every 4th locker, and this continues until all 100 people have had their turn. A locker is touched once by each person whose number is a factor of the locker number. So the number of times a locker is toggled equals the number of factors of its number. A locker toggled an odd number of times ends open, and one toggled an even number of times ends closed. Khoisnam, the queen's son, works out the open lockers before the process even begins.
